subject: SIG: SSO provider integration nuances and RBAC mapping clarifications
messages:
From: Lara James <lara.james@acme-payments.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: eli.turner@novatek.io
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: SSO/SCIM/RBAC items we still need

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the initial SIG spreadsheet. We reviewed the answers and have three quick clarifications before we mark this section as complete:

1) SCIM: we need an explicit mapping table for SCIM group -> Redwood role (i.e., which SCIM group names grant which RBAC roles). A diagram or CSV is fine.
2) SAML: confirm whether you support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows and whether RelayState is enforced/validated.
3) MFA & least-privilege: can you state where MFA is enforced (IdP vs Redwood console) and confirm any built-in role restrictions that prevent privilege escalation (e.g., are there immutable roles that cannot be self-assigned?).

Also: could you provide a small sample of provisioning events (SCIM create/update) from the last 30 days as a CSV (redact PII) so we can validate timestamps and user lifecycle?

We'd like these artifacts by EOD US Pacific on Friday (23 Jul) to stay on schedule. If a short call would help, happy to do a 20-minute sync.

Appreciate it —
Lara

Lara James
Security Operations Manager
Acme Payments
attachments: none
From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Lara James <lara.james@acme-payments.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: SSO/SCIM/RBAC items we still need

Hi Lara —

Thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble the mapping artifacts and a small provisioning sample. Quick answers up front:
- SAML: Redwood supports both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows; RelayState is accepted and validated against the configured AssertionConsumerService in the tenant config.
- MFA: enforced at the IdP level for SSO users; for local console accounts MFA is required and we enforce TOTP or WebAuthn.
- RBAC: we have a set of immutable system roles (Owner, Billing Admin) and a documented role inheritance model to reduce accidental privilege escalation.

Action plan:
- Marissa will export a SCIM group -> role CSV and a role matrix (access_role_matrix.csv).
- I'll export a 30-day provisioning events sample (audit_provisioning_events_sample.csv) with PII redacted.
- We'll include a small diagram for the SCIM sync flow (scim_group_mapping_diagram.png) and put everything into the SIG sheet (redwood_sig_answers_v1.xlsx).

We can meet Tue or Thu for 20 minutes; propose Tue 11:00am PT if that works.

Will follow up with the artifacts by EOD Wed.

Thanks,
Irene

Irene Choi
Senior Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_sig_answers_v1.xlsx (placeholder)
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lara James <lara.james@acme-payments.com>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: SCIM group mappings + RBAC notes (attachment)

Hi Lara —

Attached is the access_role_matrix.csv and a quick SCIM group -> role mapping CSV. Key notes:
- SCIM groups are synced once per minute by default; group names are case-sensitive.
- We map SCIM groups to tenant roles via the tenant admin console; the CSV follows the column format: scim_group_name, role_id, role_name, immutable_flag.
- Example mappings:
  - scim:engineering -> role:developer (limited to deployment/read-write on dev namespaces)
  - scim:platform-admins -> role:platform_admin (can manage runtime configs)
  - scim:company-billing -> role:billing_admin (immutable:true)

On SAML specifics: we accept signed assertions; our metadata supports SHA256 signatures and we validate audience and recipient. RelayState must match the expected ACS endpoint prefix; if it doesn't we reject the assertion and log a security event.

On privilege controls: three safeguards — immutable role flags, admin approval required for role assignment via console audit workflow, and an automated regression check in our rollout pipeline that flags newly created roles with broad permissions.

I've attached scim_group_mapping_diagram.png with a short legend. Let me know if you'd like an expanded export of 3 months instead of 30 days.

Thanks,
Marissa

attachments: access_role_matrix.csv, scim_group_mapping_diagram.png
From: Eli Turner <eli.turner@novatek.io>

Cc: Lara James <lara.james@acme-payments.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SCIM group mappings + RBAC notes (attachment)

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of follow-ups from our side after a quick review:

- The provisioning sample looks good, but can you include the event_id column and the user_id (redacted) so we can correlate events across systems?
- For the RelayState validation: can you share the exact ACS URL prefix pattern you validate against (we want to confirm our Okta config will pass).
- Audit logs: for completeness the auditor asked for a single example of an admin-role assignment event (who performed it + timestamp) — a single anonymized row is fine.

If you can drop the updated CSVs into the shared Drive link (I posted an upload request to the folder) by 4pm PT today, we can close this control in our review.

Eli

Hi Lara / Eli —

Thanks for the notes. Uploaded the updated artifacts to the Drive folder and attached copies to this thread: redwood_sig_answers_v1.xlsx, access_role_matrix.csv, scim_group_mapping_diagram.png, audit_provisioning_events_sample.csv.

Specifics you asked for:

- ACS prefix we validate against: https://redwood-inference.com/saml/acs/<tenant_id> (we accept any tenant_id but require the URL to start with that base).
- Admin-role assignment example included as a single anonymized row in the audit CSV.

Next steps:
- Please confirm receipt and whether the single-row audit sample is sufficient for the auditor.
- If you want expanded logs (3 months) we're happy to produce a scoped export but will need a written request.

Happy to hop on a short call if anything needs to be walked through live — Tue 11:00am PT still open on our calendar.

Best,
Irene
